title: Term-Length Credit on Northgate Protect Accident Claim Service Fees
content:
Northgate Protect Accident-tier plans with a longer coverage earn a term credit off the claim service fee. The credit is set by the number of days from the plan's coverage start date to its coverage end date:

- **1460 days or more:** the four-year credit, $10.00;
- **1095 days or more but fewer than 1460 days:** the three-year credit, $5.00;
- **fewer than 1095 days:** nothing.

The days are counted from the coverage start date to the coverage end date shown on the plan, the end date being the day after the last covered day.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Days from coverage start date to coverage end date | Term credit |
|---|---|
| 1461 | $10.00 |
| 1460 | $10.00 |
| 1459 | $5.00 |
| 1095 | $5.00 |
| 1094 | Nothing |
| 730 | Nothing |

*Hypothetical:* a plan whose coverage runs from 1 March of one year to a coverage end date of 1 March three years later spans 1095 or 1096 days, depending on whether a 29 February falls inside, and in either case earns $5.00.
